source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A model that a rule lets attack after being **destroyed** stays on the battlefield when destroyed until its unit has been **selected to attack** and made its attacks, or the phase ends, whichever comes first; then rules its destruction triggers are resolved and it is removed.

If a rule has a destroyed model fight immediately after the unit that attacked it, it is removed only once its own unit has fought, or at the phase’s end, whichever is first. So the whole unit fights together, and any Stratagem used on that unit also affects that model.
